name: Asset Alchemist
title: Companion Edition — Entertainment & Everyday Utility
subtitle: Companion Edition — Entertainment & Everyday Utility
features: Safely retired eight specialized production studios from the navigation, search, dashboard and startup: Batch Forge, Icon Foundry, Sprite Atlas, Texture Lab, Color Lab, Audio Forge, Motion Lab and 3D Inspector
Kept original retired studio source modules and immutable v3.1 release history for rollback; never deleted any local user data or license records
Redirected older saved last-view preferences for retired studios to Companion Center instead of loading a missing page
Refocused Companion Center around Continue Watching, saved video counts, favorites and entertainment-first categories for the remaining 23 focused spaces
Added up to 12 private HTTPS personal shortcuts with automatic workspace setting backup, safe URL validation and external no-opener links
Added optional locally autosaved Pocket Notes with plain TXT share/export, clear confirmation and portable settings backup
Upgraded Video Vault with 10-second back and 30-second forward, optional autoplay-next, cross-studio mini-player and direct handoff to Media Theater without large duplicate file copies
Coordinated Video Vault and Media Theater audio focus so starting one pauses the other
Kept iPhone safe-area navigation, Reactor IV, Animation Forge, existing master media, utility tools and offline workspace compatibility
Preserved Token Foundry, GitHub Pages deployment location and existing Discord application launchers unchanged
